def iniciales(nombre: str) -> str:
    """
    Return the first letter of each word in `nombre`, converted to uppercase,
    concatenated into a single string.
    
    Words are separated by any whitespace (spaces, tabs, newlines).
    Hyphens within a token do not split words.
    If no words exist, return an empty string.
    """
    tokens = nombre.split()
    return ''.join(token[0].upper() for token in tokens)

def es_palindromo(texto: str) -> bool:
    """
    Return True if `texto` is a palindrome when considering only alphanumeric characters,
    ignoring case and non-alphanumeric symbols.
    """
    filtrado = ''.join(ch.lower() for ch in texto if ch.isalnum())
    return filtrado == filtrado[::-1]

import re
from collections import Counter

def palabras_frecuentes(texto: str, n: int) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
    if n <= 0:
        return []
    tokens = re.findall(r'[a-zA-Z0-9]+', texto)
    freq = Counter([token.lower() for token in tokens])
    items = list(freq.items())
    sorted_items = sorted(items, key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
    return sorted_items[:n]
